vto.title: Vision / Traction Organizer
vto.description: The single-page document that aligns every member of the LS South Reno staff around where we're going and how we'll get there. Review this together every quarter.

core_values.title: Core Values
core_values.subtitle: The behaviors we hire, fire, review, and reward by. These define who we are.
items: Humble — Takes Jesus seriously and not themselves
Hungry — Internally motivated to excellence, drive, and execution
Happy — Fueled by the joy of Jesus, ready to bring that joy to others
Honest — Talks straight and leads with authenticity and transparency
secondary_items: Authentic Community — We do life together, not just attend church
Pursuit of God — We are a people hungry for Jesus, not just religion
Faith that Cares — We love our city and world with action, not just words

core_focus.title: Core Focus
core_focus.subtitle: Our why and our niche — what LSSR uniquely does in South Reno.
core_focus.ls_family_vision: Helping Everyone Find Everything in Jesus
core_focus.lssr_vision: Establish a Permanent Hub of Gospel Purpose in South Reno
core_focus.niche: A beacon of the gospel and a hub of Jesus' mission — raising, training, teaching, and sending disciples who make disciples in South Reno and to the ends of the earth.
core_focus.process: Guest to Member to Leader to Missionary

ten_year.title: 10-Year Target
ten_year.subtitle: Big. Hairy. Audacious. The goal that will require God to pull off.
ten_year.formula: Baptize 10% of avg attendance every year for 10 years
ten_year.formula_note: Studies show a community shifts when ~15% are reached. At 50k residents and current trajectory, consistent 10% annual baptism rate gets us there.
items: A permanent owned facility — hub of gospel mission in South Reno
1,500+ weekly attendance; 75%+ in a group, giving, and serving
Church planting actively multiplying — beginning with a new church planter
Living Stones Family Network thriving across the Mountain West
Praxis Seminary raising up the next generation of gospel leaders

marketing.title: Target Audience
marketing.subtitle: Who is the person LSSR is uniquely positioned to reach?
marketing.target_person: The spiritually curious, unchurched, or de-churched adult in South Reno — who may be open to Jesus but skeptical of organized religion or has been hurt by the church.
process_items: Discover & Deploy in a Serving Team or Leadership Role
Multiply - own a mission (local, global, or plant a group)

culture.howto_title: How to Use the Culture Guide
culture.howto_text: In every quarterly 1-on-1 and annual review, score each staff member on all four values using a 1-5 scale. A Right Person lives these values naturally. A Right Seat question is separate — someone can be a great fit to our culture but wrong for the role. Both matter.

values.name: Humble
values.description: Humility is the foundation. It's not thinking less of yourself — it's thinking of yourself less. We take Jesus seriously and not ourselves.
behaviors: Gives credit freely; takes blame personally
Asks for help without ego; actively seeks feedback
Serves outside their job description without complaint
Deflects praise toward the team and toward God
Listens more than they talk; curious, not defensive
Does not hoard information, decisions, or control

values.name: Hungry
values.description: Hungry people are self-motivated. They pursue excellence because they love Jesus and love the mission.
behaviors: Pursues personal spiritual formation proactively
Reads, learns, and brings new ideas without being asked
Sets goals beyond what's required; moves the ball
Champions improvement and resists we've always done it this way
Takes on extra responsibility when the mission requires it
Execution-oriented — follows through without reminders

values.name: Happy
values.description: Happy means we know who we are in Christ, why we're here, and find genuine joy in the work — even the hard parts.
behaviors: Brings energy to the team, not drama
Practices personal disciplines that sustain health (Sabbath, prayer, margin)
Celebrates wins — big and small — genuinely and publicly
Treats volunteers and guests with consistent warmth
Does not complain without offering a solution
Can receive hard feedback without falling apart

values.name: Honest
values.description: We say hard things with grace. No triangulating, no gossip, no sweeping things under the rug. Authenticity is not optional.
behaviors: Says what they mean in the room, not after the meeting
Admits mistakes quickly and owns outcomes fully
Brings problems forward — not sideways or backwards
Addresses conflict directly with the person involved
Keeps confidences; never leaks private matters
Does not shade truth to protect comfort or avoid awkwardness
